title: Anitabi Spots Index
description: Flat global index of individual anitabi.cn pilgrimage scene points (one row per real-world location cut that has both valid coordinates and a scene image), built by enumerating GET /bangumi/{id}/points over every id in anitabi-index.json.

count.description: spots.length, for a cheap sanity check.

spots.description: All scene points with valid geo + image. Not sorted (the client indexes by lat).

id.description: anitabi point id (stable within an anime).

img.description: Scene image as anitabi returns it (host-relative path); the client normalizes to an absolute CDN thumbnail on read.
